about: Loop-header bound table for text_budget.py. Each rule: regex on the loop header text (whitespace-normalized, string contents blanked), a bound expression over the D1 count symbols, and the reason. Bound 0 means the loop iterates a collection that D1 forces empty (DOMAIN.md clause cited). First matching rule wins.

fn_cap.why: per case the three call sites (lib.rs:2502, :2532, :2590) are mutually exclusive branches: the resolved-case branch (load-state only) and the default-basis branch each end in `continue`; D1.4 has one case
every call site returns its result as the invocation's envelope (`return blocked_envelope(..)` or the solver_blocked/imposed refusal tails), so it runs at most once per invocation

linear_supports SupportFinding::new: per prepare_boundary call at most one finding per support (missing DOF) plus one per raw restraint entry (invalid or repeated DOF), so <= g + r; prepare_boundary runs at most 4 times per invocation (its multiplicity on the graph: ordinary build, T25 check_input, and the two remaining build_model_for_members paths)
called once per raw restraint entry of each support, per prepare_boundary call: sum over supports = r; prepare_boundary runs <= 4 times
